status: PROPOSAL ONLY: not an approval, read grant, or frozen benchmark seal
scope: Conditional future-motion prediction from privileged initial geometry and sparse observed nodal motion; future recorded tool pose/opening schedule supplied. Not RGB-only perception, official DSR manipulation success, unseen-object or withheld-force-family evaluation.
rationale: Train/develop on220 historically exposed episodes, use60 prospectively declared validation and60 calibration episodes, then180 untouched confirmation episodes. Additional80 task0 episodes10-49 remain unallocated; do not silently use them.
split_identity: Three repeated physical asset IDs across six suite/task cells. All observations, augmentations, windows and controls of an episode stay together. Report per-asset/per-suite results; episode bootstrap quantifies trajectory variation conditional on these assets, not a broad material population.

observation_contract.cutoff: First60 percent of frames, as old adapter; all frames after cutoff are hidden object targets.
known: 48 prefix points selected from upper initial nodes
complete future recorded tool poses and gripper width/binary command
forbidden: held suffix residuals for algorithm selection

metric_contract.primary: Mean per-episode future coordinate RMSE; report each suite/task/asset and all completion failures
secondary: held-grasp versus released intervals defined by known commands
joint posterior predictive coverage and width if full posterior rollouts stored
metric_contract.physical_parameters: No claim of absolute material/contact-force recovery unless labels and mass/force scales are independently qualified
metric_contract.rendering: Unavailable in six local HDF5 files; no invented RGB metric

gates_before_fresh_access: Root selects/finalizes protocol after exposed-case adapter/backend validation.
Freeze learner architecture, parameterization, simulator bank design, development criteria, observation budgets and baseline recipes.
Write immutable benchmark-protocol.json and access ledger; only validation split may be opened for method selection.
Use reserved calibration split for a declared predictive calibration method; do not use confirmation residuals.
Write checkpoint/source/input-contract hashes to benchmark-seal.json before any confirmation trajectory reads.
Keep predictor and evaluator files/processes separate; perturb hidden targets and verify predictor hashes unchanged.
Report all predeclared cases including unsupported geometry, failed simulations and abstentions; no outcome-based case exclusion.
current_adapter_guard: benchmark_inputs.load_softvt_predictor and evaluator currently refuse all unexposed episodes. A deliberate sealed-protocol extension is required; this proposal does not disable that guard.
